title: Prefix-lease eviction: provable correctness for hybrid LRU+TTL
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Problem: Continuous batching and GPU memory fragmentation cause nondeterministic eviction of KV cache entries tied to conversational prefixes. Existing LRU/TTL heuristics lead to correctness edge-cases when in-flight requests reference entries that are evicted mid-batch or during prefetch demotion. Goal: design and ship a prefix-lease eviction layer that composes with LRU+TTL scoring to provide provable invariants: (1) in-flight safety (no request observes a missing prefix it expects), (2) monotonic lease handoff across shards (atomic demote/evict), and (3) bounded memory reclaim latency for high-throughput workloads. Deliverables: design doc, reference implementation in runtime evictor, validation harness, CI fuzz tests, dashboards for rollout metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and accepted by runtime and infra leads
Implementation merged with feature flag: prefix_lease_eviction
Unit+integration tests cover lease acquisition/release, demote-to-evict races, and cross-shard handoff
Fuzz harness shows zero assertion failures across 1M simulated batch sequences
SLO: <0.05% increase in median generation latency when feature enabled, and <2% eviction-caused retries
Canary deployed to non-prod GPU cluster with telemetry: eviction_retries, lease_wait_ms, prefix_miss_rate
design_notes: Introduce prefix lease object (opaque 64-bit token) acquired on first access or prefetch. Lease grants eviction immunity for that prefix for lease_duration_ms unless explicitly demoted.
Eviction scoring remains a hybrid of LRU score and TTL staleness; lease presence bumps score to LONGEVITY to postpone eviction until lease expiry or explicit demote.

Demote path: runtime signals demote intent, obtains lease transfer token; owning shard sets demote_pending=true and returns token to coordinator; coordinator orchestrates atomic handoff by ensuring recipient shard obtains new lease before old lease is released.
Shard-local invariants: LeaseAcquire -> LeaseRenew -> LeaseRelease are linearizable on a shard. Cross-shard handoff requires two-phase commit with local durable commit to lease ledger.
Memory reclamation: eviction still reclaims slab space but sets 'evicted-but-leased' markers; actual deallocation deferred until lease_release confirmation to avoid use-after-free in GPU kernels.
API surface: internal runtime config 'prefix_lease_eviction' (off/on), lease_duration_ms (default 30000), demote_timeout_ms, max_concurrent_handoffs.
Telemetry: lease_acquire_total, lease_release_total, handoff_success_total, handoff_failure_total, lease_wait_p95, evicted_while_inflight_count.
Fallback: if coordinator unavailable, demote becomes asynchronous with best-effort leases; we surface elevated prefix_miss_rate and automatically disable feature after threshold breaches.
test_plan: Unit tests: lease lifecycle, scoring interaction with LRU/TTL, memmarker correctness
Deterministic integration tests: simulate continuous batching with controlled sequence lengths and verify no in-flight prefix miss
Fuzz harness: 1M randomized batches across tenant, shard topology, and eviction thresholds (link to fuzz job below)
Chaos tests: drop coordinator messages, induce shard restarts mid-handoff, validate no double-free and lease monotonicity
Perf benchmarks: compare token throughput and tail latency with feature on/off across p3dn-24 clusters
E2E canary: step 1 non-prod, step 2 internal prod w/ <1% traffic, step 3 ramp to 25% if metrics stable
rollout_plan: Canary stage: enable for a single region and low-traffic customer group for 72 hours
Observe lease_wait_p95 < 50ms and evicted_while_inflight_count near zero before expanding
If handoff_failure_total > 0.1% or prefix_miss_rate increases > 0.5%, pause and roll back
Full rollout contingent on eviction telemetry and 48h stable performance window

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Increased tail latency due to lease handoff waits. Mitigation: conservative default lease_duration_ms and p95 instrumentation; dynamic backoff and auto-disable if tail > threshold.
Risk: Coordinator or ledger inconsistency causing stuck leases. Mitigation: implement lease TTL expiry with tombstone scans and admin reclaim tool; provide ops runbook.
Risk: Memory leak if evicted-but-leased markers not cleaned due to crash. Mitigation: on shard startup, drain outstanding leases and reconcile with tombstone ledger entries; operator script included.
perf_expectations: Steady-state throughput regression <= 1% compared to baseline for large-batch workloads
Median generation latency change < 0.05%; p99 increase bounded by 5ms for canary traffic
Eviction-caused request retries < 0.5% in synthetic stress tests
